title: Add AbExp sequence-to-expression model
body:
### What was added
Added **AbExp** to the `Sequence-to-expression models` section in `README.md`.

### What it does
AbExp predicts tissue-specific aberrant gene expression across 49 human tissues based on DNA sequence variants.
- **Input:** DNA sequence variants (VCF files).
- **Predicted Output:** Aberrant gene expression prediction scores across 49 human tissues (trained on GTEx aberrant expression calls).

### Why it is relevant
AbExp is a recently published sequence-based model/pipeline that links DNA sequence variation directly to functional regulatory outputs (aberrant gene expression across tissues), fitting directly into sequence-to-function modeling.

### Links
- **Primary Software Repository:** [https://github.com/gagneurlab/AbExp](https://github.com/gagneurlab/AbExp)
- **Publication:** [Nature Communications (2025)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-58210-w)
